name: Tsuugaku Yuugi
source:
In the morning, the lead character (boy) gets on a train as usual, but senses something different today....
He is molested by a pair of pretty sisters and finally ejaculates in train!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ028375.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]

清晨，男主角一如往常地搭上电车，却隐约觉得今天的气氛有些异样……
他在车厢里遭到一对漂亮姐妹的百般挑逗，最终竟在电车上射了出来！
